text:
Cheerful block or not, we appreciate your account and we are sorry that your companion animal travel experience left you feeling let down. You explained that the crate handling and follow-up around your pet's journey did not meet the standard you expected from Aurelia Skyways, and that the support you needed felt unclear and slow. That is not the sort of service we want anyone to face, especially when a pet's comfort and calm are part of the trip itself.

At the Companion Animal Travel Desk, we take concerns like this seriously and review them in a calm, stepwise way. A welfare coordinator will look at the comfort notes tied to the journey, along with any handling details that may have affected the crate or your pet's well-being. If an item was misplaced or delayed, the usual claim process is already in place, and the next step is to make sure the record is complete so the case can be handled without extra back-and-forth. <<FACT F118>>

We also want to be clear that complaints about animal travel are not brushed aside here. If something went wrong during check-in, transfer, or arrival care, we will pass the concern to the right team and keep the review focused on what happened and what can be improved. Where needed, we will also look at whether the travel notes captured the pet's comfort needs well enough for the people handling the shipment.

If you have already shared supporting details, thank you for doing that. If not, please send along the booking reference and any photos or notes you have, and we will attach them to the case file. That helps us check the chain of handling and respond in a way that is fair, practical, and centered on your pet's welfare.

We are sorry for the frustration this caused, and we appreciate the chance to put it right. Companion Animal Travel Desk
